title: Great - wouldn’t want to miss it!
body: Inflow really is a game changer in life, if you struggle with ADHD… but even if you‘re not certain yet, if it actually is ADHD or something else, I would recommend to get started with Inflow.
author: madamepompidu

title: This app is genuinely life changing
body: Nothing touchy feely, hokis pokis about this app. Just practical information presented in a way that was designed for your ADHD brain. Speaking personally, this app has been life changing.
author: Core Frenzy

title: Logging in every time
body: Why do I have to log in to this app every time? It’s downright annoying.
author: GherkinTreeRoot

title: Exactly what I searched for!
body: The app is amazing, especially the AI. Thank you!:)
author: Wallflower379

title: Helpful for light adhd syptoms
body: I found the app quite helpful! and it was worth to try for 1 month even if it is quite expensive at 50 $ per month. Half of the content is rather basic selfhelp/productivity stuff but there were a few new things too. But the good thing about it is the structure, with challenges and chunked up exercises that really guide you through the process, as well as the community and coach, which makes you actually make small changes in your life instead of just reading about big changes and never do them. Thank you! Question though: why do you sell usage data linked to the user to other companies? Thats really disappointing
author: Djmez
